records.title: #327084 - Turgesh, Late period cast, Closed hole
records.description: Example of a late period Turgesh AE cash with full hole, possibly because the coin itself is too thin or light to process. This might also be a recast of some local polity in the recency of the Turgesh's collapse, with very strong stylistic influences still present. Regarding the tamgha it is, IMHO, visibly not that of the same as the Otrar coins (e.g. #299540), as the latter is rhombus and has a line connection the rhombus to the arch, whereas the current specimen's tamgha is more similar to later Turgesh coins. Hard to find. Collection item of a friend and collector in China, posted with his consent.
